page.overview:
Who is Beverly?

Beverly was the assistant to Dr. Ian Malcolm in the Department of Biology at the University of California, Berkeley in .

Beverly was first mentioned when she told Dr. Malcolm a package has arrived from him via DHL. She was a very helpful assistant as he rested against his desk, she help unwrap the package. She also help contact doctors Elizabeth Gelman and Richard Levine for Malcolm upon his request. Later, she told him she could not get through to Levine via his office phone. She also informed him that photographers from a magazine called Chaos Quarterly came to photograph his whole office including the map of possible existing dinosaurs and told him they appeared polite and may be Swiss. Malcolm told her not to worry and allowed her to head home.
